column7: A session insert that fails after SAML JIT provisioning and reconcile refuses the login with no session, keeps the account (class C, docs/atomicity-exempt.tsv JIT row) and writes one failed auth.sso_login_session_failed event naming the account and client. The retry property class C rests on: TestCompleteSAML_RetryAfterSessionInsertFailure_ConvergesOnCleanLogin (a second ACS reuses the account and ends with exactly the grants of a fault-free login). OIDC sibling: TestCompleteSSO_SessionInsertFailure_Audited. SAML-TAILS-1 item 2.
